title: How is Franklin D. Roosevelt connected to Lee Jung-jae?
description:
Four real photos connect Franklin D. Roosevelt to Squid Game star Lee Jung-jae.

Franklin D. Roosevelt → George VI → Elizabeth II → Emmanuel Macron → Lee Jung-jae

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

Photo credits:
Photo 1 by Harris & Ewing, photographer, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:The_Roosevelts_with_the_King_and_Queen_of_England_sailing_on_the_USS_Potomac,_June_9,_1939_(cropped).jpg
Photo 2 by Royal Air Force official photographer, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Royal_Air_Force_Bomber_Command,_1942-1945._CH20901.jpg
Photo 3 by Number 10, CC BY 2.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Prime_Minister_Boris_Johnson_G7_Summit_Day_One_-_51242021245.jpg
